How may Drone BeeGee-TooTooT-oo zzzervice the colony?|BG-222, to guests at Duke Piddock's party on Geonosis|<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt">{{FFG|story=The Long Arm of the Hutt|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game}}</ref>}}
'''BG-222''' was a [[J9 worker drone/Legends|J9 worker drone]] with a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] persona who was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], BG-222 attended a private party that was held on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Piddock]] of the [[Gogum Hive]]. During the event, BG-222 was summoned by the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Vrixx'tt]] on a number of occasions to act as a [[Translator/Legends|translator]] for him.<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt" />

==Characteristics==
BG-222 had [[Color/Legends|white]]-colored plating and a large head with multi-faceted [[Photoreceptor/Legends|optical apparatus]]. He had a cheerful and over-enthusiastic persona. He spoke with a monotoned voice and suffered from a flaw common to [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of his class whereby when translating [[Language/Legends|languages]] he would translate phrases from an [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] perspective.<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt" />
